headline: Paper reports a 5B controllable video world model streaming at 24 fps on one L20
summary: An arXiv technical report describes Astronex-World 1.0, a 5.35B-parameter model built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B prior with camera and 64-dimensional action conditioning. The authors report that its causal form generates 832×480 video at 24 fps in real time on one NVIDIA L20 48 GB GPU, after a five-stage post-training recipe run on two such GPUs. On the authors' WBench Full 289 evaluation it scores 70.0, compared with 68.9 for YUME 1.5 (also post-trained from the same 5B prior) and 69.7 for 14B Helios; the paper also reports a weaker interaction score and long-horizon drift. These are paper-reported results, not independently reproduced findings.
